message.reasoning:
The web environment only surfaces fiscal 2024 full-year figures (10-K) — no quarterly FY2025 data is available. So the only hard, reported figures I can rely on are FY2024: net sales $648,125M, operating income $27,012M, net income $15,511M, diluted EPS $1.91, operating cash flow $35,726M; prior year FY2023: sales $611,289M, operating income $20,428M, net income $11,680M, EPS $1.42.

That's a solid picture: ~6% sales growth, operating income +32%, EPS +35%, strong OCF. That supports a buy.

Price $69.96 with bid 69.94 / ask 69.98. Limit price should be close to market — buy limit around $70.10 (slightly above ask to ensure fill) — but "close to current market price". Let me place limit at $70.05 for 71 shares = $4,973.55, under $5,000.

Actually 71 × 70.05 = $4,973.55. Good. Within mandate: buy only, WMT only, ≤$5,000 per order, ≤$10,000 total today (this is $4,973.55). Limit near market.

Also need to check total today: no other orders placed, so fine.
